findings.note: ESPN Betting picks Loveland over 53.5 receiving yards at -112, a yards market rather than receptions. It cites 7.4 targets a game over his last five games, Cole Kmet being out for the season and a 57-of-61 snap share, but also notes he drew only three targets against the Saints in Week 11.

CBS shows the case against: Loveland had just three catches on three targets in Week 11. The case for: he caught a career-high 10 of 13 targets against Detroit in Week 18 last season, and CBS lists his yards prop at 54.5.

CBS says Detroit gives up the fifth-highest target share to tight ends but admits Chicago hasn't gotten Loveland going as much as it wanted this year. It also says Detroit allows the fewest yards after the catch, and it picks Lions 31, Bears 30.
